primary_sources.used_for: Author-supplied focus state indicators need sufficient contrast against adjacent background; unmodified user-agent appearance is exempt. Scoped3:1 comparison uses computed author colors and actual adjacent background.
Keyboard focus indication is assessed in keyboard modality, separate from pointer focus.
